findings.claim: The controller imports space-id.pipe from another module's routes directory (@/modules/spaces/routes/pipes/space-id.pipe) instead of going through that module's domain layer, which is the exact anti-pattern the module structure guide calls out by name as something not to imitate.

The service imports assertMember from another module's routes/utils (@/modules/spaces/routes/utils/space-assert.utils) rather than that module's domain layer, even though the service already injects IMembersRepository and could use that instead.

A second Nest module is defined at the module root instead of under routes/, deviating from the canonical module structure used elsewhere in the repo (e.g. src/modules/delegate/routes/delegates.module.ts) and inconsistent with this module's own domain/entitlements-repository.module.ts placement.
createSpace() replaces the shared nameBuilder() with faker.company.name(), an unexplained drive-by change unrelated to the entitlements work being reviewed.
